content.label: I’ve had this for almost a year and I’m disappointed that no new tunes have been created. Need to do something because it gets old fast.

I have ADHD and autism and I am currently in a post baccalaureate program to help you get into medical school. Since I have been using focus@will I have been able to study without disruption for over an hour at a time. I’m so grateful for focus at will and the work that they’re doing to help non-neuro typical people. I also recommend this for neuro typical’s its a great app all around.

Wow. Very impressive app. Highly recommend the medium energy ambient channel.

Only four stars because the UI is kind of hard to look at. I look forward to seeing the look and feel of the app improve over time; I anticipate I will drop the cash for the lifetime subscription sometime soon.
I am highly distractible. When I use this app, I focus beautifully. Thank you, thank you, thank you!
Love the channels and convenience! Great app to have for studying / working

title.label: Propeller is like sitting on an airplane

content.label: The propeller sound helps me ignore other distractions, and I can work for longer periods if time.

title.label: Love it when it works but it’s buggy

content.label:
Seriously helps me focus as a programmer. But I have often run across bugs like:

Freezing requiring app restart 
Turning off screen to save battery and music stops a few minutes later
Pressing play and nothing happens. Have to change music types in order to get music again.
I’ve been enjoying Focus@Will for years to stay productive. I love the music selections, and the timer is perfect to keep me on track with my timed pomodoro sessions.
Love this app, been using it for years and has helped me achieve deeper concentration and productivity, saving hundreds of hours with better focus!

title.label: I really want to love the app, but...

content.label: The app is great when it works. Most of the times, however, it does not. It least for me. It logs me out at random. When this happens, and I attempt to log back in, it states that my subscription has expired - which is not the case. Customer support is also impossible to reach. Hence, it’s just a waste of $12+ per month.
I can jam in a flow for hours, undoubted by distractions. This thing is liquid focus.

title.label: Focus is possible! Adaptable sound on easy app

content.label: Sound & music adjusts to my preference and learns what heightens my focus by eliminating tracks that distract. Great variety of types of sound, and pace.

I started using app when I was in graduate school. It really helped me focus when studying. It has such a calming effect on me. Allows me to settle my mind and keep centered on task at hand. Started using at work and I get so many comments about music on my computer. Been a paying member for two years now and highly recommend.

title.label: The best aide to focused work

content.label: I  bought a lifetime subscription to Focus@will  and am thrilled that I did. The tailored music to meet my focusing needs is simply amazing. It makes me a better physician. Try it you will get it and love it too!!!!!

title.label: 3 stars for the App/ F@W service 4 Stars

content.label:
6 weeks using F@W and the app. I’m not 100% sold that “the music “ works, but I’m less of a skeptic then when I first signed up. On a few occasions I’m definitely more productive/ focused but can’t tell if it’s the music or not? I don’t see any improvement in creativity or the creative mindset. I contacted support about this they said it takes time. I’m willing to give it a few more weeks or even months before I make my final decision.
That sad the app needs some work, it’s a bit glitchy,  especially when hooked up to another device ( car doc). Hooked up via Bluetooth in my car it cuts off when my screen shuts off, sooo basically completely useless if not hooked up with a cable. Not 100% sure it’s the app but on some Devices I have trouble linking the app threw Bluetooth. In a nut shell developers need to fix Bluetooth issues for the mobile app
Keeps me focused, reduces stress when I’m overloaded and need to focus and crank out a bunch of work.  I’m a big fan of Alpha Chill (Medium) when I have something complex to figure out.
Great service. Would give it a 5 if it would be possible for premium subscribers to use service offline.
Love it

I’ve been using F@W for about a month and bought the annual subscription. When I’m using it, I do find that the time goes by and I see that I’ve stayed on task almost without fail. As an independent consultant on billable hours, productivity is essential. I recently went off Adderall bc of related health concerns and have needed an alternative. I’m a life-long musician but don’t usually listen to music while working. The guide for selecting a channel steered me to Alpha and that seems to be just interesting enough to keep that part of my brain active but just uninteresting enough not to be a distraction. Now to get it to turn itself on!

One challenge - it sometimes gets stuck and won’t do another round of timed focus. A simple restart works but I don’t know why it’s failing. Otherwise 5 stars and worth the investment.

The latest version has me signing in every time I use it. The music cuts in and out - VERY annoying when I just want to focus and get some work done. Love the tunes. When things are working smoothly I crank out my work. Perhaps there’s a bug fix on the future?
My productivity is always higher when using this app.
This is what all apps should be. It’s wonderful and it does the trick. I hope everyone downloads it and it’s around forever.

I’ve just started using this app because I love music and I like to listen to music while I work and study. What I’ve realized is, I cannot concentrate when I’m studying and I’m listening to music that has vocals and party beats. This app is great. The music options are great and since I am laid back for the most part, the music fits into my mood well.

If it wasn’t for the free trial asking for billing information I would download the app. Soo ... I’m not even going to risk it . Also a lot of reviews are saying that it’s hard to cancel subscription. Not worth the risk.

I’ve signed up for the app. It automatically stored my username and password but will not let me sign in.  I’ve hit the “forgot your password” link which circles me back to “you already have an account try signing in”
I found a phone number and called and left a message there and I’ve emailed for several days. Hope I didn’t get scammed. I was truly looking forward to this.

I work from home and sometimes it is nearly impossible to keep moving forward on the same task with the distractions of incoming mail and phone calls.  Focus@will not only helps keep me moving forward,  it helps my attitude and I actually enjoy what I’m doing.  It’s a really valuable tool for me and I can’t say enough good about it.
This app really, really works for me. I like Uptempo.  I just put on my headphones and get busy. Pretty soon I’m in the zone.

I tried it and it worked nice but no better than just listening to Apple Music. I canceled the subscription within the required time and they still billed me. I downloaded the app again and tried to cancel and the app crashes after you press the cancel subscription on the final page. I tried on both my iPhone and iPad.

title.label: Not perfect but still a fan

content.label:
I upgraded to lifetime about the same time some of the app “improvements” happened. 

I have trouble with the app stopping play for no reason every time I use it as well as sometimes taking a long time to load.  This is with a 4G network and unlimited bandwidth as well as on a 1G internet connection. 

I would love to be able to download a couple of hours of content to avoid the stoppage and lag I often experience. Since I’m a lifetime subscriber, this shouldn’t be a concern for DRM although like Amazon Music, you can continually re-provision me for the content I’ve downloaded. 

Even with the quirks, I still use daily.

I’ve used focus@will for two years now.  One of the best investments I’ve made.  I work in multiple environments: remote in airports and coffee shops, from home, and in an open floor office setting.  This app allows me to engage mentally with the task at hand and tune out distractions.  It’s helped me “lock in” and get more work done.  

In short, if you’re contemplating getting focus@will, just do it.  You won’t regret it.  Don’t miss out.
Great app, I feel the need to listen to music during work as an entrepreneur but regular music gets you caught up in the lyrics. It’s odd saying this but I do feel as if it has helped my productivity

I’m very satisfied with the selection. It is very effective way to focus up.

I strongly recommand this service to somebody wants to improve his productivity. 

But the app quality needs to be improved little bit.

For an example,
I want to keep previous status of current music, when airpod automatically stops the music. (airpod is automatically stop the current music when one side is detached)

Before Focus, I was short, fat, and bald. Now with Focus, I'm tall, lean, and have a full head of hair. But really, I did the trial a while back, and opted not to pay. Then, heard it mentioned again on a podcast, decided not to be cheap and go with a paid subscription. It wasn't easy as I had listened to podcasts all day and I still miss my podcasts but I definitely feel that it's made great improvements on my ability to focus. I set the timer for 35 minutes and do my best to stand there and work. I have a standing desk. Ok, so do the trial, and if you can afford it, just go with the paid subscription and test out the various sounds to find the one that works for you as some I love and others I totally hated. And sometimes I'll switch up just for a change of pace. Get Focus and you'll be better able to focus if you can only get that person in the cubicle next to you to shut up about Trump.

title.label: Productivity tracker is making me crazy

content.label: I followed the Instructions to turn it off and it still pops up. I sent an email to complain and got no response. Make it easier to nix productivity tracker please!!!!!
This company and app have cracked the secret code for great focus. Setting the duration for your focus session, then rewarding yourself (in whatever way you see fit) after is awesome. I love it.
I’m an attorney with ADHD, and this app is extraordinarily helpful at aiding my focus. Love it!
App crashes almost every time I unplug my headphones, it consumes a lot of power, I wish there would be an offline mode. Subscription is not cheap for what it does.

In an open office environment, I find myself bouncing from conversation to conversation and not getting actual work done. Even when I listen to Spotify I find myself getting pulled away and leaving the day unaccomplished. I did the two week free trial and was hooked! I can tune in and get in the zone and finally drown out the distractions. My co workers are jumping on board too :)
I’ve been using focus at will for over a year. I love putting it on and getting “flow” state. Super helpful!

I’m giving it five stars on the productivity side, but I’d give it another five  just because you can stream unlimited music tracks from across a wide array of styles without having to worry about lyrics, which makes it a no-brainer for background music since it’s unquestionably family and guest-friendly. I use it for work (Alpha Chill or Focus Spa) as well as for company (Classical Piano or Acoustic). Worth every dime.
I am easily distracted when working but Focus@will helps me get into deep work fast and stay on task and productive. Thank you for such an easy way to be more productive!
The app never worked for me. Every time I’d press play, it would go to the sign in screen and then go blank after I signed in. I had such high hopes for it.
Update it for iphone X, please.

The product is just fantastic. I recommend it constantly.

Marc
Expensive but still worth every penny.

title.label: Best way to focus is no music

content.label: I've only listened to classical/baroque and although The selections chosen are nice-sounding, it's extremely psychically disruptive and hurts the brain when music gets abruptly cut off without the musical phrase finishing just to jump the a new piece. Also I've learned from this trial that the best way to focus is to do work without music.
Love the app. Great variety. Please make an Apple Watch app too!
Not sure if this is happening to anyone else. But the cutouts are a little distracting which is the opposite of what I’m going for here.

title.label: Log in doesn’t work / waste of time

content.label: If you love to waste time, download this app. I tried creating account with Facebook only to have it fail multiple times due to a cryptic error. Your productivity will increase by not getting this app.

It doesn’t store my login information, so I have to login every time I want to use this app.

 The music is somewhere between acceptable and clearly just computer generated babbling. 

I have no idea how people can concentrate to this stuff. I love electronic classical music, but this is like a mockery of it.

Its nature sounds are pretty good though, so I give it 2 stars. I don’t think that’s enough to justify 10 bucks a month though.
